name: sendIntent
description: Send an Android intent. This is the real superpower — you can fire intents at any app to open URLs, share files, trigger actions, start activities. Use for controlling other apps and system functions.

parameters.name: dataUri
parameters.description: Data URI, e.g. https://example.com or file:///path/to/file

parameters.name: packageName
parameters.description: Package name to target a specific app, empty for any
